messages:
oncall-bot: [INCIDENT P1] Detected broad 502s for /v1/generate in us-east-1. Pager triggered @channel. War room: https://tiny.red/warroom-612987

alex: ack — I'm oncall and joining war room now :raised_hands:

ops_lead: taking owner for mitigation. Assign @mike_eng to debug runtime, @julia_support pls start customer impact list + comms draft.

mike_eng: on it. pulling logs. seeing spike at ~04:15 UTC. KV cache errors and `java.lang.NullPointerException` in inference-worker-3. Running:
```
kubectl logs -l app=inference -n prod --since=15m | grep -E "KVCache|NullPointer" -n
```

sara_pm: quick impact summary for status page: elevated 502s for text generation endpoints in us-east-1. Some hosted API customers seeing failures; Dedicated pools might route traffic. Drafting initial status update.

julia_support: customer list ready for top-affected: Acme Corp, FinCo Analytics, HealthApp. Drafting targeted emails with workaround (route to us-west) and support link.

infra_sre: suggest soft restart of inference service on affected hosts before rollback. command:
```
sudo systemctl restart redwood-inference && sleep 10 && journalctl -u redwood-inference -n 200
```

alex: I pushed temporary fallback routing to light-quantized model variant, traffic split 80/20. Monitoring error rate now.

ops_lead: good move. @sara_pm please post 'Investigating' on status page with impact = "API failures for some customers" and note war room link. No ETA yet.

julia_support: sending targeted emails to top customers, copying legal & account execs. Will attach migration steps and ticket link.

oncall-bot: Pager acknowledged by alex. Escalation level: L1 oncall. War room active: https://tiny.red/warroom-612987. Current state: triage and mitigation in progress. React with :thumbsup: when you've joined the war room.
